_hinweis: Bögen für die Bausteine-Probe (Baustein B, Schritt 1). Vorschlag von Claude, 26.11.2026. Jeder Bogen ist ein KI-Bild mit neun Teilen, gelesen zeilenweise von links oben. teile: Name je Teil in dieser Reihenfolge. breite: drei Werte = Zielbreite des größten Teils je Zeile in Pixeln bei 390 Pixeln Gartenbreite, die Stufen 1 und 2 werden mit 45 und 72 Prozent der Größe von Stufe 3 gezeichnet (gemessen an der längeren Seite), weil die KI junge Pflanzen fast so groß malt wie ausgewachsene; neun Werte = Zielbreite je Teil.

kraeuter.eingabe: Opaque gouache storybook illustration, thick matte paint, visible broad brush strokes, rich warm colors, simplified shapes, no outlines. A neat sheet of nine separate garden plant studies arranged in a 3 by 3 grid on a plain flat light grey background, nothing else, no cast shadows, generous empty space between the items, every plant seen from above at about 45 degrees, soft daylight from the upper left. Top row, left to right: a tiny lavender seedling with three short grey-green shoots and no flowers, a small young lavender clump with only grey-green leaves and no flowers yet, a large round lavender bush full of purple flower spikes. Middle row, left to right: a tiny strawberry seedling with three small leaves, a young strawberry plant with green leaves and a few small white flowers, a large strawberry plant full of ripe red strawberries. Bottom row, left to right: a tiny cabbage seedling with two small leaves, a young cabbage plant with loose open leaves, a large round green cabbage head with wide outer leaves. Every plant stands directly on the plain background without any soil, pot or ground. Each item complete and isolated, not touching the edges of the picture. No text, no labels, no frames.
